strict_case_summary.interpretation_limit: Two cases establish a local funnel failure, not a universal architecture scaling law.

cross_scale_confounders.evidence: Both 100K winners cleared the 0.003 eV gate by less than 0.000125 eV after repeated fixed-role architecture search.
PairToken selected epoch 39/40 and Pair PreNorm selected epoch 59/60, so neither 100K gain was observed after a stable post-best tail.
100K uses source rows 100000-150000; 500K uses rows 500000-550000. The gain change therefore mixes scale and evaluation-cohort effects.
The K1 PairToken contracts use 31,240 steps and 3,998,720 presentations at 100K versus 234,360 steps and 29,998,080 presentations at 500K.
Row-paired bootstrap measures row uncertainty, not seed-to-seed training variation; both promoted gains are seed42 only.

PairToken retained only 18.3% of its gain when the K1 reference received more data and optimization. This is consistent with, but does not prove, the base model learning overlapping relation information.

contextual_noncausal_scale_evidence.observation: K1 and GPTrans-T beat EdgeState at matched 500K, but their fixed 20M-presentation full runs were worse than the converged EdgeState checkpoint.
contextual_noncausal_scale_evidence.confounder: EdgeState selected epoch 30 after roughly 101.36M full-train presentations, about 5.07 times the K1/GPTrans budget; evaluation roles and recipes also differ.
contextual_noncausal_scale_evidence.disposition: Do not classify this as a proven architecture rank reversal until convergence chains terminate.

contextual_noncausal_scale_evidence.observation: The historical EdgeState 100K gain did not transfer to its initial full run.
contextual_noncausal_scale_evidence.confounder: The full run used a lossy atom/bond feature contract with proven radical/closed-shell input collisions and an underconverged schedule; restoring complete OGB categories reduced official-validation MAE from 0.189450 to 0.102063 eV.
contextual_noncausal_scale_evidence.disposition: This was contract drift, not evidence that EdgeState inherently fails to scale.

rejected_explanations: a single coarse molecule class that can be routed reliably
row-bootstrap uncertainty as a substitute for training-seed uncertainty
the statement that all 100K positive mechanisms fail at scale

literature.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
literature.relevance: Repeated optimization of a noisy finite-sample selection criterion can create selection bias comparable to algorithm differences.

literature.title: Deep Learning Scaling is Predictable, Empirically
literature.relevance: Learning-curve shape and data scale must be measured rather than assuming a fixed small-scale rank transfers.
